title: umamanipraharshitha/Whatsapp_ai_extended-version
summary: 基于WhatsApp的AI助手，结合了RAG（检索增强生成）技术，提供医疗知识库问答功能。用户可通过WhatsApp设置、查看和取消提醒，同时提问获取答案。该助手利用JavaScript实现，适用于需要便捷医疗信息查询的场景。，基于模型推理的架构
description: A WhatsApp-based AI assistant that combines reminders with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for Q&A. Users can schedule, list, and cancel reminders via WhatsApp while asking questions answered from a medical knowledge base.
